snippet.title: SEASON 9 LAUNCH TRAILER | THE FINALS
snippet.description:
Season 9 launches Year 3 with the new megacity map FANGWAI CITY, the 8v8 mode POINT BREAK, a unified World Tour 2.0, and a wave of updates and QoL improvements!

And remember, Contestants: everyone started in the arena somewhere 💥

–

SEE YOU IN THE ARENA! PLAY FREE NOW: 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2073850?utm_source=youtube
PlayStation: https://www.playstation.com/games/the-finals/
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/the-finals/9PGD71CMDS0Z

Follow the show for the latest news:
X / Twitter: https://x.com/reachthefinals
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/reachthefinals
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@reachthefinals
Official Discord: https://discord.com/invite/thefinals

Check out the Season 9 soundtrack! https://lnk.to/TheFinalsS9OST

–

THE FINALS is a world-famous, free-to-play, combat-centered game show! 
Fight alongside your teammates in virtual arenas that you can alter, exploit, and even destroy. Build your own playstyle in this first-person shooter to win escalating tournaments and lasting fame. 

#TheFinals #ReachTheFinals #TheFinalsGame
